extra.codec: protobuf-codec (rust-protobuf 2.28; prost-codec needs protoc, not installed)
extra.hibernate: raft-rs has no hibernate/quiesce API; plain raft-rs measured (every group ticks and heartbeats)
extra.layout: one Raft group per database; 3N RawNodes; one thread per node drives all its groups; one shared LogFile per node (group commit across groups)
extra.storage: MemStorage (+snapshot override) + LogFile per node (fdatasync), async ready
